releases.notes:
## Just-Tiers 1.2.1 beta

This release fixes settings loading, network requests and keyboard focus, and draws
nametags with less work. It supports Minecraft 1.21.10, 1.21.11, 26.1, 26.1.1, 26.1.2,
26.2 and 26.3, with a separate JAR for each version.

- One invalid value in `config/justtiers.json` no longer resets every setting. That
  value falls back to its default and the rest of the file is kept. In site toggles,
  selected gamemodes and custom colors, only the affected site falls back. A file that
  is not valid JSON is copied to `justtiers.json.bak` before defaults load.
- A player's nametag badge is rebuilt only when your settings or that player's answers
  change, not every frame. The lookup screen also stops rebuilding its tooltips every
  frame.
- Player and Mojang requests give up after 20 seconds, and NovaTiers downloads after two
  minutes. Before, a server that stalled partway through a response could hold a request
  slot until the game closed.
- A NovaTiers refresh that lists no ranked players no longer replaces a populated index.
  It used to show every NovaTiers player as unranked.
- `/justtiers lookup` retries a site whose nametag request failed. Before, it could show
  the old failure until you looked the player up a second time.
- While a site is cooling down or paused, nametags stop retrying it every frame. A
  deferred request no longer resets the player's retry delay.
- A NovaTiers HTTP 503 without a Retry-After header no longer pauses downloads for 60
  seconds. NovaTiers now follows the same cooldown rule as the other sites.
- The palette controls stay available with nametag tiers off, because the palette also
  colors lookups and the download bar. Controls that only affect nametags say which
  switch turns them back on.
- The narrator announces which gamemode tile is the current selection.
- Resizing the window or changing the GUI scale keeps keyboard focus on the same lookup
  cell or gamemode tile.
- Hover highlights and tooltips in the gamemode picker and lookup screen use the same
  bounds as clicks. The bottom edge of the gamemode grid no longer highlights a tile
  that a click would miss.

Install the JAR for your exact Minecraft version with matching Fabric API and YACL.
Minecraft 1.21.10 and 1.21.11 require Java 21 and YACL 3.8.2 or newer. Minecraft
26.x requires Java 25 and YACL 3.9.4 or newer, except 26.3 which requires YACL
3.9.7 or newer and Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer. Other targets require Fabric
Loader 0.19 or newer. ModMenu remains optional. Server installation is unnecessary.
Existing settings carry over unchanged.

## Just-Tiers 1.2.0 beta

This release supports Minecraft 1.21.10, 1.21.11, 26.1, 26.1.1, 26.1.2, 26.2 and
26.3, with a separate JAR for each version.

- With several sites enabled, turn on Prefer selected gamemodes, or run
  `/justtiers preferselected`, to show each site's selected gamemode. A player
  without a placement there shows their best placement on that site. With one site
  enabled, its selection always applies, and the command says so.
- Choose any site's gamemode with `/justtiers gamemode <site> <slug>`. The command
  warns when the selection will not show under the current site settings.
- Gamemodes a site adds before a mod update appear in nametags and lookups with a
  name derived from the site and no icon, after the known gamemodes. They cannot be
  selected until a mod update registers them.
- The lookup screen shows up to eight recent names as buttons, most recent first,
  and `/justtiers lookup` tab completion offers them. They are kept in memory for
  the current game session only and never saved.
- Other Fabric client mods can read Just-Tiers' answers through the tier-query API
  described in [docs/api.md](../api.md). It follows the nametag and site switches
  and never sends offline-mode or NPC UUIDs to the leaderboards.
- When a new lookup leaves a row with fewer cells, keyboard focus moves to that
  row's last remaining cell instead of being lost.

Install the JAR for your exact Minecraft version with matching Fabric API and YACL.
Minecraft 1.21.10 and 1.21.11 require Java 21 and YACL 3.8.2 or newer. Minecraft
26.x requires Java 25 and YACL 3.9.4 or newer, except 26.3 which requires YACL
3.9.7 or newer and Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer. Other targets require Fabric
Loader 0.19 or newer. ModMenu remains optional. Server installation is unnecessary.
Existing settings carry over unchanged.

releases.notes:
## Just-Tiers 1.1.7

PvPTiers replaces the discontinued MCTiers integration, and PvPHQ joins SubTiers
and NovaTiers. This release supports Minecraft 1.21.10, 1.21.11, 26.1, 26.1.1,
26.1.2, 26.2 and 26.3, with a separate JAR for each version.

- Use PvPTiers in the former MCTiers yellow and PvPHQ in gray `#D2D2D2`.
- Enable or disable each site independently in configuration or with
  `/justtiers site <site> [true|false]`. The old display-mode selector and
  `/justtiers mode` command are replaced by these toggles.
- With several sites enabled, show each site's best placement. With exactly one
  enabled, prefer its selected gamemode and fall back to its best placement.
  Disabling all four sites hides nametag tiers. Explicit player lookups still
  include all four sites.
- Support PvPHQ's 11 gamemodes and middle divisions, such as MT3. Middle divisions
  rank between high and low divisions of the same tier. Inactive placements are
  not treated as retired, and peak placements are ignored.
- Migrate existing MCTiers gamemodes and custom colors to PvPTiers. Old single-site
  display modes preserve that choice; the old all-sites mode enables all four.
- Update lookup rows, configuration previews, color palettes, icons and diagnostics
  for all four sites and 43 supported gamemodes.
- Add Minecraft 1.21.10 compatibility alongside the six existing targets.

Install the JAR for your exact Minecraft version with matching Fabric API and YACL.
Minecraft 1.21.10 and 1.21.11 require Java 21 and YACL 3.8.2 or newer. Minecraft
26.x requires Java 25 and YACL 3.9.4 or newer, except 26.3 which requires YACL
3.9.7 or newer and Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer. Other targets require Fabric
Loader 0.19 or newer. ModMenu remains optional. Server installation is unnecessary.

releases.notes:
## Just-Tiers 1.1.6 beta

This release improves lookup reliability for all six supported Minecraft versions:
1.21.11, 26.1, 26.1.1, 26.1.2, 26.2 and 26.3.

- Keep last-known successful placements visible during refresh and temporary outages,
  with a finite stale grace period. Lookup tooltips show answer age and refresh status.
- Bound concurrent and queued requests per source, prioritize explicit lookups over
  background nametag work, and honor server Retry-After cooldowns.
- Validate NovaTiers bulk records before publishing an immutable index. Malformed or
  conflicting player records remain unavailable rather than appearing unranked.
- Bound per-player cache and retry retention, and reuse immutable nametag settings to
  reduce repeated allocation.
- Keep each lookup session's placements and freshness together. A later refresh with
  identical placements cannot reset an older session's answer age.
- Centralize request admission and successful name/skin lookup retention, including
  retry when failure is observed before the eviction callback completes.

Use the JAR for your exact Minecraft version with its matching Fabric API and YACL.
The required Java versions and dependency versions are unchanged from 1.1.5.

releases.notes:
## Just-Tiers 1.1.5

This beta release provides a separate mod JAR for Minecraft 1.21.11, 26.1, 26.1.1,
26.1.2, 26.2 and 26.3. Choose the JAR for your exact game version.

- Minecraft 1.21.11 requires Java 21, Fabric Loader 0.19 or newer, Fabric API for
  1.21.11 and YACL 3.8.2 or newer for 1.21.11.
- Minecraft 26.1, 26.1.1, 26.1.2 and 26.2 require Java 25, Fabric Loader 0.19 or newer,
  Fabric API for the game version and YACL 3.9.4 or newer for that version.
- Minecraft 26.3 requires Java 25, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, Fabric API for 26.3
  and YACL 3.9.7 or newer for 26.3. ModMenu remains optional on every target.

Settings screens preserve the previous active settings if saving fails and keep the
draft available for retry. Settings commands apply their changes to the current session
and warn if the file could not be saved. The lookup screen continues showing partial
results when one leaderboard fails, and a new lookup retries failed requests.

Existing configuration files remain supported. Nametags still affect world display;
tab-list and chat names are unchanged.
